title: Suggestion: Adding an “Emotional” Category to Brain.fm for Deep, Moving Music
body:
Hi,

I’ve been using Brain.fm for a while now, and I really appreciate the focus-enhancing and relaxing tracks. However, I noticed that there aren’t any emotional tracks in the app. I personally enjoy deep, emotional, and melancholic music, and I think many users would appreciate having tracks that evoke strong emotions while still maintaining the benefits of Brain.fm’s science-backed approach.

It would be great if you could consider adding an “Emotional” category, with music that feels deeply moving—perhaps something with sad, reflective, or cinematic tones. I believe this could enhance the app’s versatility and attract even more users who connect with music on an emotional level.

Thanks for considering this suggestion! I’d love to hear your thoughts.
